"""
Token bucket rate limiter.

The implementation uses a monotonic clock (by default ``time.monotonic``) to
track elapsed time and refill the bucket.  It is deliberately simple and
relies only on the Python standard library.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from typing import Callable


class TokenBucket:
    """
    A token bucket rate limiter.

    Parameters
    ----------
    rate: float
        Number of tokens added to the bucket each second. Must be > 0.
    capacity: int
        Maximum number of tokens the bucket can hold. Must be >= 1.
    clock: Callable[[], float], optional
        Zero‑argument function returning the current time in seconds.
        Defaults to ``time.monotonic``.  Supplying a custom clock makes the
        class easy to test.

    The bucket starts full (i.e. ``capacity`` tokens are available).
    """

    __slots__ = ("_rate", "_capacity", "_clock", "_tokens", "_last")

    def __init__(
        self,
        rate: float,
        capacity: int,
        clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic,
    ) -> None:
        if rate <= 0:
            raise ValueError("rate must be greater than 0")
        if capacity < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be at least 1")

        self._rate: float = float(rate)
        self._capacity: int = int(capacity)
        self._clock: Callable[[], float] = clock

        # Bucket starts full.
        self._tokens: float = float(self._capacity)
        # Record the time of the last refill (initially now).
        self._last: float = self._clock()

    def _refill(self) -> None:
        """Refill the bucket based on elapsed time."""
        now = self._clock()
        elapsed = now - self._last
        if elapsed > 0:
            added = elapsed * self._rate
            self._tokens = min(self._capacity, self._tokens + added)
            self._last = now
        else:
            # No time has passed; keep the previous timestamp.
            # This branch also protects against clocks that go backwards.
            self._last = now

    def allow(self) -> bool:
        """
        Attempt to consume a single token.

        Returns
        -------
        bool
            ``True`` if a token was available (and consumed), ``False`` otherwise.
        """
        self._refill()
        if self._tokens >= 1.0:
            self._tokens -= 1.0
            return True
        return False


__all__ = ["TokenBucket"]
